boundary: Closed official seed42/E7 cached-distance diagnosis on the already registered .25/.5/.75 and original1 ratios only. No new ratio scored or selected, no encoding or training. AP groups are descriptive posthoc partitions. Inferred bank margin is 2*fused-Signal under the existing equal-energy contract; cnn/transformer/mamba cached outputs each include the Signal prefix. A fixed positive/negative pair crossing is not a whole-query Rank-1 threshold because other gallery winners may change. Cached metrics do not replace actual adapted-model verification or establish a unique feature-learning cause.
